_about: F7 (CODE_JOB_F7_typologies.md, 8 Nov 2026): the typology library. One entry per typology, in MASTER_PLAN Phase B order. Figures come from each typology's spec (Emergency hub: Claude Link eh/specs/emergency_hub.md, parts 1-4, 9 Nov 2026) with register ids; a typology whose spec has not passed J.B.'s gate shows no figures. Status: specified (spec parts 1-3 final), in progress (spec being written; test-fit boards exist), not started (research file only, checks/research_typ/). Update this file when a spec changes. The Emergency hub spec is published with the tool (J.B., 9 Nov 2026): tool/f1/specs/emergency_hub.md, a verbatim copy; re-copy it when Cowork changes the spec.
_icons: tool/f1/icons/*.svg (copied from Claude Link docs/icons, first pass, 8 Nov): servers, refuge, clinic, pool, greenhouse. Programs without a drawn model show their name only.

notChecked: Plans are hand fits by Cowork, self-checked after the last fixes; the tool checks them again (T-reach, dead ends, room widths, egress doorways: all 8 pass, 9 Nov).
Detailed design is not checked (J.B., 9 Nov): fixture layouts, door swings, intake and exhaust placement, finishes. Results within 0.5 m of a limit are 'tight: check in design'.
Room sizes: most are drawing choices; clinic minimums are an Alberta guideline; CSA Z8000 and TIA-942 are unread.
The 6.0 m hall storey carries every height and MW result and has no source (drawing choice).
Edmonton cooling: the chiller model is outside its maker's stated range at −30 °C: a placeholder.
Noise, air intakes, drains, refrigerant-leak distances, fire access and truck turning are '?' on every fit.
Edmonton hand fits use licensed lot lines, so their plans are not shown here; 64 Airport Rd NW is shown from the tool's own layout on City parcels.
